technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder & Manufacturers of UG Cable & Joints & Terminations shall jointly furnish an Undertaking stating that they would offer UG Cable & Joints & Terminations which are manufactured with same type and manufacturing process as that of the UG Cable & Joints & Terminations whose Type test reports have been uploaded.
